press_references.value: FalconX Partners with Ethena on $1 Billion Warehouse Financing Facility to Expand Institutional Lending Capacity

partnership_announcements.description: FalconX announced a $1 billion secured lending facility with Ethena through an SPV, allowing Ethena-backed capital to support overcollateralized institutional credit. FalconX will act as originator, servicer, and collateral manager.

press_references.value: FalconX and Sygnum Bank Partner to Bridge Regulated Banking and On-Chain Tokenized Credit

partnership_announcements.description: FalconX and Sygnum Bank formed a strategic partnership in which Sygnum will act as lender of record via its Desygnate platform to provide its institutional and private wealth clients access to FalconX’s on-chain tokenized structured credit facility.

press_references.value: FalconX Enhances Digital Asset Services with Prime Brokerage and Custody Solutions

partnership_announcements.description: FalconX announced a new partnership with Fireblocks Trust Company to provide qualified custody services for U.S.-based institutional clients on the FalconX platform.

press_references.value: FalconX, World Liberty Financial Partner to Enable Institutional Access to USD1

partnership_announcements.description: FalconX and World Liberty Financial announced a partnership enabling institutional trading, credit, and custody support for WLFI’s USD1 stablecoin on FalconX’s platform, offering deeper liquidity and integration for treasury workflows.

press_references.value: FalconX, Marex partner to provide clients with efficient cross-margining for digital asset derivatives

partnership_announcements.description: FalconX announced a new partnership with Marex to offer select non‑US institutional clients efficient cross‑margining for digital asset derivatives across CME and digital‑native exchanges, including F&O clearing and execution.

press_references.value: FalconX Integrates Copper’s ClearLoop for Off-Exchange Settlement

partnership_announcements.description: FalconX and Copper announced a new partnership to integrate Copper's ClearLoop settlement network into FalconX's trading platform, enhancing off-exchange settlement and custody protections for institutional clients.

press_references.value: FalconX Joins Lynq as a Launch Partner, Further Signaling Industry Support for the Real-time Interest-bearing Settlement Network

partnership_announcements.description: FalconX has joined Lynq as a launch partner, becoming a day one user of the real-time, interest-bearing settlement network for digital assets. This partnership aims to enhance capital efficiency and real-time settlement for institutional market participants.

press_references.value: Crypto platform FalconX partners with Standard Chartered

partnership_announcements.description: FalconX has partnered with Standard Chartered to leverage the bank's banking and foreign exchange services for its institutional crypto clients, marking FalconX's first collaboration with a global traditional bank. The partnership will start in Singapore and expand to other regions.

press_references.value: FalconX Carries Out ‘First’ CME Group Solana Futures Block Trade

partnership_announcements.description: FalconX partnered with TP ICAP's Fusion Digital Assets to enhance liquidity and data solutions in February 2024.

overview_description.description: FalconX is a digital assets prime brokerage that provides trading, financing, and custody services tailored for financial institutions. The company focuses on facilitating access to global liquidity in the cryptocurrency market. FalconX employs data science techniques to enhance trade execution and optimize efficiency for its clients. The platform supports a range of digital asset transactions, enabling institutions to manage their investments effectively. By offering comprehensive solutions in the digital asset space, FalconX meets the needs of institutional clients seeking to navigate the complexities of cryptocurrency trading and management.

about_short_description.short_description: FalconX is a digital assets prime brokerage providing trading, financing, and custody services.

product.name: Trading
product.description: Institutional digital-asset trading across spot, derivatives, foreign exchange, and electronic execution channels, with access to liquidity across multiple venues.

product.name: Financing
product.description: Digital-asset financing services including margin loans, flexible settlement, over-the-counter lending, DMA loans, structured products, and yield-generation arrangements.

product.name: Custody
product.description: Institutional digital-asset custody with integrated asset safeguarding and staking capabilities for supported assets and jurisdictions.

product.name: Direct Market Access (DMA)
product.description: UI- and API-based access to spot and derivatives trading on global digital-asset exchanges, with borrowing, cross-margining, and transfer capabilities.

product.name: FalconX 360
product.description: A unified institutional platform for digital-asset trading, financing, custody, portfolio management, reporting, transfers, and risk oversight.

product.name: Electronic Options
product.description: Electronic trading for institutional digital-asset options, including block execution and options market access through supported FalconX entities.
